shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A woman in a navy cardigan sits at the sideboard-side window seat and asks a question, a woman in a burgundy sweater sits at the sideboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a mustard jacket sits at the patio-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: A man in an olive polo enters, sits at the patio-side window seat, and speaks. A woman in a navy cardigan replies.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a mustard jacket asks a question. A woman in a navy cardigan answers.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sideboard end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the patio doors, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
